text:
emily: kicking off a tiny canary for v3.4.0 in eu-west - 9% cohort. change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. dashboard: https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1767777778
deploy-bot: rollout started: v3.4.0 -> 9% (eu-west). cohort id: c-9912
ops-eng: watching, will post metric snaps.
deploy-bot: t+4m snapshot: p50=110ms p95=200ms 5xx=0.2%
marco: seeing a tail for a subset hitting rdx-small-quant on edge-eu5, p95 ~480ms. tagging @ops-eng.
tasha: pulling logs now. snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T02:12:10Z] host=eu5-05 model=rdx-small-quant latency=490ms kv_cache_evictions=14 gc_ms=90 errors=0.9%
[2026-03-23T02:12:11Z] host=eu5-06 model=rdx-small-quant latency=520ms kv_cache_evictions=21 gc_ms=130 errors=1.4%
```
ops-eng: pattern looks like increased kv-cache churn and GC on quant path after tokenizer tweak in notes: https://git.redwood/release-notes/v3.4.0
emily: request manual pause at 9% while we triage.
deploy-bot: rollout paused at 9% (manual by emily). action_id: a-3347
release-manager: recommend regional pin to previous stable variant v3.3.9-quant for eu-west for 30m to mitigate user impact while we investigate.
marco: agree with pin-first. queueing rollback if pin doesn't improve within 12m: `/deploy rollback --service=inference --from=v3.4.0 --to=v3.3.9 --region=eu-west --reason="canary_quant_tail"`
deploy-bot: routing override available; change >10% would need window lock. current change within window - allowed.
ops-eng: applying routing override now: cohort c-9912 -> v3.3.9-quant-stable (eu-west). override id=r-7219
deploy-bot: routing override applied r-7219.
ops-eng: monitoring after pin. will report in 6m.
marco: t+6m after pin - p95 down to 170ms, 5xx 0.25%, GC back to baseline.
emily: looks good. propose hold 10 more minutes then resume to 20% with health gates (p95<250ms and 5xx<0.6%).
release-manager: +1, will add an incident note if we keep the pin or execute rollback.
emily: thanks everyone, handing watch to ops-eng. end.
